verdict.rationale: Docs clearly separate transactional email as its own category with its own use cases and templates (bento-docs-3, bento-docs-37, bento-docs-38, bento-docs-49), distinct from broadcasts/marketing sends (bento-docs-34). However, no evidence explicitly confirms that transactional sends bypass marketing unsubscribe/suppression lists or that transactional and marketing traffic maintain separate sending reputation/IP pools tied specifically to transactional mail. Missing for 10: explicit statement that unsubscribed contacts still receive transactional mail, documented suppression-list bypass logic, and evidence of reputation isolation between transactional and marketing streams.
